verdict.rationale: The manifesto commits to OpenTofu being "Backwards-compatible" so that existing code keeps working for years, and the docs promise drop-in compatibility with Terraform configurations. Community users report that migrating from Terraform is easy. However, these are high-level pledges and cross-product migration notes, not documented release-to-release compatibility guarantees or upgrade guides. Missing for 10: per-release upgrade/migration guides, a formal versioning or compatibility policy (e.g. semver or deprecation rules), changelogs documenting breaking changes, and independent corroboration of smooth upgrades between OpenTofu versions.
